title: 모음 ㅒ: 얘기, 걔 — 누구 얘기해요?
objective: Read and say syllables with ㅒ, and tell 걔 apart from 개.
summary: Learn the vowel ㅒ and read casual words like 얘기, 얘, and 걔.

task.title: Read, choose, and write
task.line: Say each word out loud first, then write or choose the answer.

words.meaning: this one, this kid (casual; short for 이 아이)
he, she, that kid (casual; short for 그 아이)

letters.sound: [yae] ㅐ with a quick y in front (ㅑ + ㅣ)

letters.as: Keep the y after ㄱ; it changes the word.

letters.sound: Short forms: 이 아이 → 얘, 그 아이 → 걔, 이야기 → 얘기
letters.as: Casual spoken forms used with friends and family

exercises: Choose the Korean word for the English: ① dog (개 / 걔) ② that kid (개 / 걔) ③ talk (애기 / 얘기)
Write the short spoken form in the blank: ① 그 아이가 누구예요? → ____가 누구예요? ② 이 아이도 가요? → ____도 가요? ③ 이야기해 주세요. → ____해 주세요.
Read out loud and write in Roman letters: ① 얘가 ② 걔가 ③ 얘기예요
Put the letters together and write the word: ① ㅇ + ㅒ ② ㄱ + ㅒ + ㄴ + ㅔ ③ ㅇ + ㅒ + ㄱ + ㅣ
answers: ① 개 ② 걔 ③ 얘기
① 걔 ② 얘 ③ 얘기
① yaega ② gyaega ③ yaegiyeyo
① 얘 ② 걔네 ③ 얘기
